name: Hilbert–Pólya operator search
structure: Find a self-adjoint operator whose spectrum matches the nontrivial zeta zeros; RH follows from self-adjointness.
notes: AI generates candidate operator families (Berry–Keating variants, quantized maps); numerics screen spectra against known zeros.

name: Weil explicit-formula positivity
structure: RH is equivalent to positivity of the Weil distribution on a class of test functions. Search test-function constructions that certify positivity.

name: Nyman–Beurling / Báez-Duarte criterion
structure: RH iff the constant function is approximable in L2(0,1) by dilations of the fractional-part function. Optimize approximation coefficients numerically at scale.

name: Li coefficient positivity
structure: RH iff Li's lambda_n >= 0 for all n. Compute deep lambda_n sequences; mine for structure predicting positivity.

name: Random matrix / GUE statistics
structure: Zero statistics match GUE eigenvalues (Montgomery–Odlyzko). Mine large zero datasets for deviations and new invariants suggesting the underlying operator.

name: de Branges spaces program
structure: RH from positivity conditions in de Branges' theory of Hilbert spaces of entire functions. AI audits and extends the known obstruction landscape.

name: Explicit-formula conjecture mining
structure: Generate and test thousands of candidate identities/inequalities relating primes and zeros; promote survivors to human review.
